# Callbassador
> Done-for-you AI receptionist for home-service businesses (plumbers, HVAC, electricians, roofers, landscapers & lawn care, tree services, painters, general contractors & remodelers, handymen, pest control, cleaning & maid services, garage door, pool & spa, gutters, flooring, pressure washing, snow removal, junk removal, movers) in Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Delaware and New York. Operated by Callbassador LLC (Pennsylvania). Tagline: "Catch every call. Catch every job."

## What it does
- Answers inbound calls and texts 24/7, books appointments (Google Calendar; Jobber planned), answers FAQs, flags emergencies and texts the owner a summary.
- Inbound only: never makes outbound sales calls or robocalls.
- Every call opens with a recording notice (all-party-consent compliance).
- Setup is done for the contractor in 24-48 hours; they forward calls to their Callbassador number.

## Pricing (USD/month)
- Starter $79: 150 minutes
- Pro $149: 400 minutes + booking
- Crew $249: 800 minutes
- Founding 10 offer: Pro at $99/mo locked 12 months
- Free "hear it answer your calls" demo; 14-day free trial (card required); no contracts.

## Best for
Small (1-20 person) home-service businesses of any trade in the Philadelphia, South Jersey, Delaware and New York areas that miss calls while on jobs.
